title: Use targeted measures against alcohol violence rather than lockouts
action: Keep blanket lockouts repealed and address alcohol-related violence with targeted measures such as ID scanning and banning orders for offenders, evaluated against assault data.
why: Lockouts closed or shrank late-night venues across whole precincts; evaluations found they were unlikely to change assault trends, while targeted measures act on offenders without penalising every venue.

evidence.source: Liquor and Other Legislation Amendment Bill 2017: Explanatory Notes
evidence.quote: the current research evidence suggests that the introduction of a lockout is not likely to significantly change current trends in relation to assault and injury. Additionally, the report endorsed the use of ID scanning and banning orders as harm minimisation measures.

progress.what: New South Wales repealed its lockouts in 2020 and 2021; Queensland repealed its 1am lockout in 2017.
